program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0))
                                 (grid-positions g)))
                  (color (at g (fst (fst cells)) (snd (fst cells))))
                  (r0 (min-of fst cells))
                  (r1 (max-of fst cells))
                  (maxc (max-of snd cells)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc r)
                       (let ((rowcells (filter (lambda (p) (= (fst p) r)) cells)))
                         (if (or (empty? rowcells) (= r r0) (= r r1))
                             acc
                             (let* ((rc (max-of snd rowcells))
                                    (end (- (* 2 maxc) rc)))
                               (reduce (lambda (a c)
                                         (if (in-bounds? r c h w)
                                             (set-cell a r c color)
                                             a))
                                       acc
                                       (range (+ rc 1) (+ end 1)))))))
                     (cellmap g (r c v) 0)
                     (range 0 h))))))
